title: Lucky Catch Cruises
specs: Cruise near picturesque lighthouses, historic civil war forts, and the “Seal Rocks”.
Learn about lobster habits, conservation efforts and the difference between hard shells, shedders, shorts, culls, and keepers.

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The Lucky Catch and St. Croix are available for a wide variety of private charters which can be customized to fit the needs of your group. Charter rates start at $550 for 1 1/2 hours. Besides lobstering charters some common events include birthday parties, corporate outings, cocktail cruises, birdwatching and island

blurb: Guests participate in hauling lobster traps or relax cruising near lighthouses, forts, and Seal Rocks. Learn about lobster habits, conservation, and lobster types. Lobsters caught can be purchased at wholesale price and taken to a nearby restaurant for dinner.
